diagnosis: The dead-letter queue redrive route allows users to inspect and requeue failed payment billing messages based solely on the req.params.invoiceId path parameter. The handler never validates whether the authenticated merchant owns the target invoice, permitting any user to trigger message re-processing and potential double-crediting on other merchants' failed invoices.
exploit_request:
POST /api/billing/dlq/redrive/inv_enterprise_991823 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing-ops.internal:3003
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_merchant_token>
Accept: application/json
